shared_elements: low-relief carving covering the face of an upright rectangular slab/pillar
repeated small motifs arranged in columns
justification: Both are upright rectangular fields carved in shallow relief with motifs organised into vertical columns, but that is about as generic a correspondence as can be, and the actual content differs entirely: A shows only abstract chevron/herringbone bands and linear geometric shapes with no figure, while B shows an elaborately costumed anthropomorphic figure with a large plumed headdress accompanied by sign-blocks. There is no shared creature, object, posture or relationship between elements, and the rendering conventions (flat incised zigzag repetition versus modelled figural relief) are unrelated.
